author: A9
t_plus_1: data_cutoff equals as_of_today minus 1 calendar day in timezone; today is not in any computed window
new_old_rule: OLD iff at least one effective order has paid_date < analysis_start (paid_date <= start-1). Month-start or year-start must not replace analysis_start. Customers with zero effective orders are outside the buyer identity set.
effective_order: order_status != 交易关闭 AND net_gsv > 0. net_gsv = actual_amount - sum(refunds where refunded_at <= data_cutoff). Refunds after data_cutoff are T14 late events and must not change this as_of.
gsv: sum of net_gsv of effective orders in the stated sales_scope and window. Not list price / GMV. A9 fixtures use decimal yuan so the arithmetic is visible; if C0 freezes integer fen, convert 1 yuan = 100 fen without mixing units in one assertion.
f_grain: F is count of distinct effective order_id. One order with three lines contributes F=1. Two orders on the same day contribute F=2. Line COUNT(*) is a fail.
sample_channels: Synthetic label CH_SAMPLE only. Real 派样 channel ids are PENDING_C0/A2. A9 does not guess production aliases.
sample_default: CH_SAMPLE orders count in first-purchase identity and RFM unless an explicit exclude path is selected.
sample_current_only: Drop CH_SAMPLE from current-period sales metrics only. Identity, lifetime F, and history_recomputed=false stay unchanged.
sample_history_recompute: Drop CH_SAMPLE from current sales AND from historical identity/RFM. Identity and F may change. Must echo 历史口径已重算.
sales_vs_history_scope: Independent. Applying sales_scope to history identity is a fail.
member_cross: Member is independent of new/old. UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN and is not coerced to non-member. Member GSV and new/old GSV must not be added as if they partitioned the same total.
ratio: Raw 0-1. Zero denominator returns null, never a fake 0 or 0%. Percent display is caller formatting.
leap_yoy: Calendar-year shift, clamp to the last valid day of the target month. Display the actual dates. Unequal day counts are allowed and must be echoed. Must not roll into the next month and must not 500 on missing Feb 29.
last_week_same_weekday: Subtract 7 days from both bounds. Not ISO week-number alignment.
empty_vs_invalid: User-provided end < start before cutoff clamp => INVALID_PERIOD (HTTP 422). A valid range that has zero overlap with [min_date, data_cutoff] => SUCCEEDED_EMPTY / NO_AVAILABLE_DAYS, and must not compare a full previous month.
mtd_on_month_start_tplus1: If as_of_today is the 1st, data_cutoff is the previous month's last day, so the requested month has 0 available days. Return empty for that month. Do not emit the previous full month as MTD, and do not emit the requested month's full future calendar.
cohort_t05: Freeze last-year snapshot members. Do not reselect by this-year F. Original-channel-not-returned includes switchers. Store-wide-not-returned excludes switchers. Original-product repurchase is a separate set.
history_truncated: If history coverage does not reach the customer's true first purchase, mark HISTORY_COVERAGE_TRUNCATED and do not claim full-lifecycle F.
